# Firestop Company

> > Firestop Company provides specialized fire protection and firestop services for residential, commercial, industrial, and educational construction projects across the Pacific Northwest and Western states.

Based in Tigard, Oregon, Firestop Company specializes in firestop installation and fire protection solutions for new construction and renovation projects. The company serves Northern California, Oregon, Washington, and Idaho with expertise across multiple sectors including residential, commercial, industrial, and educational facilities.

## Service Categories

- [Residential Firestop Services](https://www.firestopcompany.com/residential): Residential firestop services for new construction and renovation across Northwest
- [Commercial Firestop Services](https://www.firestopcompany.com/commercial): Commercial firestop services for construction and renovation across Northern CA, OR, WA, ID
- [Industrial Firestop Services](https://www.firestopcompany.com/industrial): Industrial firestop services for construction and renovation projects in Western states
- [Educational Firestop Services](https://www.firestopcompany.com/education): Educational facility firestop services and construction projects across Northwest region
